The '''Endorian Researchers Guild''' was a scientific organizations active in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Linear Miasma Scientists]], a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] who studied the [[Linear Miasma]] nebula, were part of the guild.<ref name="SWG:LM" />
